verdict.rationale: HubSpot documents post-send statistics for marketing emails via its API, customizable dashboards for campaign performance, and multi-touch attribution for conversions. The evidence never names opens, clicks, or unsubscribes specifically, and never shows per-workflow-step reporting or time-series views. missing for 10: explicit open/click/unsubscribe metric documentation, per-automation-step (workflow) analytics, over-time trend reporting, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can read opens, clicks, unsubscribes, and conversions per campaign and per automation step, over time

citations.quote: You can also query details about the post-send statistics of a specific email or set of emails.
Your HubSpot account includes flexible, customizable dashboards that allow you to see campaign performance data in one place and easily share reports with stakeholders.
Drive revenue with multi-touch attribution and customer journey analytics that show what's actually working.
